posts.title: I Built My Own Hair Electrolysis Machine
posts.description: Axiom: body hair is cringe. That's how I feel, at least. I decided to build a machine that lets me permanently remove it using electricity. There are lots of ways to get rid of body hair temporarily. Shaving is probably the most common. There are other methods that last a little longer, like epilation or waxxing. These remove the entire hair, which takes more time to grow back than just cutting it
